"

A galvanic cell separates oxidation and reduction into two half-cells. At the anode (−) the metal is oxidized and releases electrons; at the cathode (+) a metal ion is reduced. The electrons travel through the external wire from the anode to the cathode, and the salt bridge closes the circuit with ions.
